verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official CLI (salesforcecli/cli), installable via npm, with documented commands for data queries, scratch orgs, Apex tests, and agent creation and activation. A community user independently describes it as a 'passable command line tool'. missing for 10: in-depth first-party CLI documentation beyond command listings, and evidence of commands specific to Sales Cloud objects or workflows rather than platform-wide ones.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With SFDC I get a passable command line tool
